strings.rulebook.auto_follow: Following suit: your lowest card of the led suit.
strings.rulebook.auto_lead: Leading: the lowest card of the suit you hold most of.
strings.rulebook.auto_never: Taking a hand and rematch votes are never played for you.
strings.rulebook.auto_opening: In the opening trick: your lowest spade, otherwise your highest card.
strings.rulebook.auto_thulla: No card of the led suit: your highest card.
strings.rulebook.basic1: All 52 cards are dealt. Whoever holds the Ace of Spades leads it to open.
strings.rulebook.basic2: Follow the led suit if you can. If you can't, any card you play is a thulla.
strings.rulebook.basic3: Get rid of all your cards to escape. The last player still holding cards loses the round.
strings.rulebook.empty_hand_draw_discard: Win a trick with your last card and you draw a random card from the discard, then lead.
strings.rulebook.empty_hand_draw_next: Win a trick with your last card and you draw a random card from the next player's hand, then lead.
strings.rulebook.empty_hand_instant_exit: Win a trick with your last card and you escape at once; the next player leads.
strings.rulebook.endgame_draw_discard: With two players left, a leader who wins with their last card draws a random card from the discard.
strings.rulebook.endgame_draw_opponent: With two players left, a leader who wins with their last card draws a random card from the opponent.
strings.rulebook.endgame_thulla_ends_round: With two players left, the first thulla ends the round: whoever picks up is the {0}.
strings.rulebook.fast_forward_off: Rounds play to the last card even when the loser is certain.
strings.rulebook.fast_forward_on: When the loser is certain, the round ends straight away.
strings.rulebook.hand_taking_anyone: Before the lead, anyone may ask for the hand of the next active player; the first accepted request wins. That player escapes.
strings.rulebook.hand_taking_leader: From the second trick, the leader may take the whole hand of the next active player before leading by tapping Ask for hand. If they accept, they escape.
strings.rulebook.hand_taking_off: Taking another player's hand is off.
strings.rulebook.loser_title: The last player holding cards is the {0}.
strings.rulebook.opening_simultaneous_off: The opening trick is played in turn from the Ace of Spades.
strings.rulebook.opening_simultaneous_on: Everyone answers the opening Ace of Spades at the same time, within 10 seconds.
strings.rulebook.opening_thulla_off: The opening trick never causes a pick-up; its cards go to the discard.
strings.rulebook.opening_thulla_on: Careful: a thulla counts in the opening trick, so someone can pick up the opening pile.
strings.rulebook.thulla_ends_trick_off: After a thulla, play carries on around the table; at the end the highest card of the led suit picks up everything.
strings.rulebook.thulla_ends_trick_on: A thulla stops the trick at once; whoever played the highest card of the led suit picks up the pile.
strings.rulebook.tip1: Run out of a suit early: once you can't follow, every card of that suit someone leads lets you give a thulla.
strings.rulebook.tip2: Watch what others pick up. A pile someone takes tells you which suits they now hold.
strings.rulebook.tip3: Leading your highest card can leave you with the hand and no cards; keep a low card for later.
strings.rulebook.title: Rules
strings.rulebook.why_ace: The round opens with the Ace of Spades, and its holder has to lead it (R12).
strings.rulebook.why_follow: You hold a card of the led suit, so you have to play one of them (R18). Only those cards are lit.
strings.rulebook.why_server: The server checks every card. A card it refuses goes back to your hand with no penalty (R47).
strings.rulebook.why_turn: It isn't your turn yet; your cards light up when it is.
strings.rulebook.word_bhabhi: Bhabhi: brother's wife; the loser's title.
strings.rulebook.word_court: Yakka, badshah, begum, ghulam: ace, king, queen, jack.
strings.rulebook.word_escape: Nikal gaya, bach gaya: got away, escaped.
strings.rulebook.word_haath: Haath: hand; also the right to lead ("haath mera hai").
strings.rulebook.word_haath_lena: Haath lena: to take another player's hand.
strings.rulebook.word_suits: Hukum, paan, eent, chidi: spades, hearts, diamonds, clubs.
strings.rulebook.word_thulla: Thulla: the off-suit card that stops a trick (literally slang for a police officer).
strings.tutorial.explain_ask: You're asking {0} to hand over their {1} cards. If they accept, the cards join your hand and {0} sits out safe for the rest of the round. They can refuse.
strings.tutorial.hint_leader: "Leads" marks who led this trick. The highest card of that suit takes the hand.
strings.tutorial.hint_legal: Lit cards are the ones you can play now. Hold the led suit? Then you must follow it.
strings.tutorial.hint_quick_chat: A thulla! Tap Chat to say something, from "Le lo bhai!" to a chai emote.
strings.tutorial.hint_take_hand: Before you lead, you can ask the next player for their whole hand. If they accept, they're out and safe, and you lead with all of it.
strings.tutorial.step1: You have the Ace of Spades. Everyone throws a spade. No punishment on the first trick.
strings.tutorial.step1_done: The opening trick goes to the discard. Your Ace was highest, so you lead next.
strings.tutorial.step1_hint: The round opens with the Ace of Spades. Tap it, then tap again to play.
strings.tutorial.step2: Bilal has no hearts. His off-suit card is a thulla. The highest heart picks everything up. That's Sara, not you.
strings.tutorial.step2_done: Sara took the whole pile into her hand. Thullas make other people pick up.
strings.tutorial.step2_hint: You hold hearts, so you must play a heart. Only those are lit.
strings.tutorial.step2_lead: Noor leads a heart. You have hearts, so you play one.
strings.tutorial.step3: No diamonds? Throw your worst card. Sara's K♦ is the highest, so she picks up.
strings.tutorial.step3_done: That was your thulla. Running out of a suit early gives you more of them.
strings.tutorial.step3_hint: You have no diamonds, so any card goes. Throw one you want rid of.
strings.tutorial.step4: Two low clubs left. Play low and let someone else take the hand.
strings.tutorial.step4_done: Play your last card low and let someone else take the hand. You're out, you're safe.
strings.tutorial.step4_hint: Follow clubs with a low one.
strings.tutorial.step5: Two left and the leader has no cards? They draw from the other player. Play until it's confirmed.
strings.tutorial.step5_done: You're out, and Sara is left holding a card: she's the Bhabhi. Now play a real round.
strings.tutorial.step5_lead: Two players left. Sara leads her last card.
